provenance.whatThisRecords: A phase reply of ten files in which nine are valid JSON and one, backend/src/features/attachments/routes.ts, is not. From offset 54463 to offset 59777 (5314 characters, to the end of that file's content) the model wrote the code verbatim: 181 raw line breaks and 3 double quotes not preceded by a backslash. The next file, backend/src/features/versions/routes.ts, is escaped correctly again (136 escaped newline sequences after the last raw line break). The committed repair escapes the raw line breaks, and the parse then fails at the first unescaped quote, offset 56207.
provenance.provesWhat: Hazard 1 item 10's repair is correct and not sufficient: it moved the first error from offset 54463 to offset 56207 and the reply was still unparseable. A raw line break inside a string has one reading; an unescaped double quote inside a string does not (the same character could end the string), so no rule places it without guessing. The sentence telling the model never to put a raw line break in a string (src/prompts.ts, both patch-producing prompts) was in the repository when this reply was produced. It is one sample and says nothing about how often this happens.
